title: Source rights and reuse register — Egyptian Labour Law knowledge workstream
policy: Public availability is not equivalent to permission to redistribute or use commercially. No permissions are claimed. Do not bypass access restrictions. Prefer source links, short factual summaries, article pinpoint references, hashes of files lawfully obtained, and provenance metadata over copying full protected compilations.
